name: Bethor's Scroll
summary: Bethor Iceshard writes counter-incantations to help Apothecary Renferrel brew a protective draught against Thule Ravenclaw's dark sorcery. The scroll holds the key to facing the Scourge necromancy guarding Fenris Isle.

sections.title: Countering the Necromancer
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard writes arcane formulas to guide the Royal Apothecary Society in brewing a restorative potion. Apothecary Renferrel receives the scroll at the Sepulcher. Its incantations counter the debilitating hexes Thule weaves around his fortress.

sections.title: A Colleague's Betrayal
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard recognizes Thule Ravenclaw's handiwork in tainted ichor recovered from Rot Hide gnolls. Thule was once a promising young mage of the Kirin Tor. When the Scourge rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and served the Lich King. Bethor learns Thule survived and directs Rot Hide attacks across Silverpine Forest from Fenris Isle. Knowing his former colleague's spellcraft well, Bethor writes the scroll.

faq.q: What is written on Bethor's Scroll?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard inscribes specialized arcane incantations on the scroll. He once studied alongside Thule Ravenclaw and knows the necromancer's preferred spells, so his formulas show how to brew an alchemical counter-potion.

aliases: who do i give the scroll to
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel, stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, receives the scroll. He uses its magic to create a protective draught.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Renferrel need magical incantations for a potion?
aliases: why does an apothecary need spells
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel practices alchemy rather than traditional sorcery, and admits he rarely weaves such overt forces into his concoctions. Ordinary anti-toxins cannot pierce the Scourge curses shielding Thule, so Bethor's arcane formulas are needed to make the brew effective.

faq.q: Who was Thule Ravenclaw before turning to the Scourge?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, Thule Ravenclaw was a promising young human mage and an associate of Bethor Iceshard. When the Lich King marshaled his undead armies, Thule abandoned his fellow spellcasters and pledged loyalty to the Scourge.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see how knowledge of a fellow spellcaster's signature magic can become a potent countermeasure. The scroll reflects the Kirin Tor's fractured past.
As an undead, you can see Forsaken spellcasters and apothecaries bringing their talents together through this parchment. It joins Dalaran's old arcane training with the Sepulcher's alchemical craft.
